name: Asteria Scale sentence-level semantic translation benchmark
origin: All source sentences, contexts, sense groups, and reference translations were written originally for Asteria Scale; no corpus or publication sentences were copied.
intendedUse: sentence-level word-sense evaluation for independent and joint semantic planners

fieldSemantics.sourceText: The current sentence shown to the user.
fieldSemantics.previousContext: Optional input-only history. It may inform a model but must not be appended to displayed source or reference output.
fieldSemantics.referenceTranslation: A manually curated Russian reference for the complete current sentence.
fieldSemantics.targets: Two to six exact, non-repeated source spans with ordered sense groups.
fieldSemantics.groupId: Zero-based and sequential within one target; it is the stable outcome index.
fieldSemantics.expectedTranslation: A canonical visible Russian rendering that belongs to the gold sense group.
fieldSemantics.surfaceScorable: True when the gold sense has a Russian surface distinct from every distractor; false keeps the target in sense scoring but excludes it from strict visible-surface scoring.
fieldSemantics.contrastSetId: Pairs cases with identical sourceText and target candidates; only input-only previousContext may change the gold senses.
